title: A coprime factorization of a monic polynomial modulo I lifts after an etale extension trivial modulo I
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $f\in A[x]$ a monic polynomial. Let $\bar f=\bar g\bar h$ be a factorization of the image $\bar f$ of $f$ in $(A/I)[x]$ such that (1) the leading coefficient of $\bar g$ is a unit of $A/I$, and (2) $\bar g$ and $\bar h$ generate the unit ideal of $(A/I)[x]$. Then there exist a ring map $A\to A'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the induced map $\alpha:A/I\to A'/IA'$ is an isomorphism, and polynomials $g',h'\in A'[x]$ with $f=g'h'$ in $A'[x]$ (with $f$ mapped to $A'[x]$) lifting the given factorization: the images of $g'$ and $h'$ in $(A'/IA')[x]$ are the images of $\bar g$ and $\bar h$ under $\alpha$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M1 (lemma-lift-factorization-easy) and its proof (uses Lemma Tag 07LX lemma-lift-invertible-element and Lemma Tag 0ALH lemma-lift-factorization-monic; the latter uses Algebra Example Tag 00UA, the universal factorization ring, and Lemma Tag 07M0 lemma-localize-upstairs)

proof.text: *Making the leading coefficient a unit upstairs.* Let $\bar c\in A/I$ be the leading coefficient of $\bar g$, a unit by (1), and choose $a\in A$ with image $\bar c$. Put $A_1=A_a$. By [lem-weil-pbc-lift-invertible-element], $\operatorname{Spec}A_1\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], the induced map $\alpha_1:A/I\to A_1/IA_1$ is an isomorphism, and $u=a/1$ is a unit of $A_1$ whose image $\bar u$ in $A_1/IA_1$ is $\alpha_1(\bar c)$.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07M1 (lemma-lift-factorization-easy), first sentence ('Applying Lemma lemma-lift-invertible-element we may assume that the leading coefficient of g-bar is the reduction of an invertible element u of A'; Lemma Tag 07LX)

proof.text: *Reduction to monic factors.* Apply $\alpha_1$ coefficientwise: $\bar g_1=\alpha_1(\bar g)$, $\bar h_1=\alpha_1(\bar h)$. Since $\alpha_1$ is a ring map compatible with $A\to A/I$ and $A\to A_1\to A_1/IA_1$, the image $\bar f_1$ of $f$ in $(A_1/IA_1)[x]$ is $\alpha_1(\bar f)=\bar g_1\bar h_1$; since $\alpha_1$ is injective, the leading coefficient of $\bar g_1$ is $\alpha_1(\bar c)=\bar u$. Put $G=\bar u^{-1}\bar g_1$ and $H=\bar u\bar h_1$. Then $GH=\bar f_1$ and $G$ is monic. $G,H$ generate the unit ideal: if $p\bar g+q\bar h=1$ in $(A/I)[x]$, then $\alpha_1(p)\bar g_1+\alpha_1(q)\bar h_1=1$, i.e. $(\bar u\alpha_1(p))G+(\bar u^{-1}\alpha_1(q))H=1$. $H$ is monic: if $A_1/IA_1=0$ every polynomial is monic; otherwise $\bar f_1$ is monic ($f$ is monic), hence nonzero, so $H\neq0$, and since $G$ is monic the top coefficient of $GH$, in degree $\deg G+\deg H$, is the leading coefficient of $H$; thus $\deg\bar f_1=\deg G+\deg H$ and the leading coefficient of $H$ equals that of $\bar f_1$, which is $1$.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07M1, second to fourth sentences ('Then we may replace g-bar by u-bar^{-1} g-bar and h-bar by u-bar h-bar. Thus we may assume that g-bar is monic. Since f is monic we conclude that h-bar is monic too'); the transport along alpha_1, the coprimality and the leading-coefficient argument (including the case A_1/IA_1 = 0), left implicit in Stacks, are written out

proof.text: *The monic case.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-lift-monic-coprime-factorization-etale] to the ring $A_1$, the ideal $IA_1$, the image $f_1$ of $f$ in $A_1[x]$ (monic) and the factorization $\bar f_1=GH$ of step 2 into monic polynomials generating the unit ideal. It gives a ring map $A_1\to A'$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A_1$ etale and $\beta:A_1/IA_1\to A'/IA'$ an isomorphism (note $(IA_1)A'=IA'$), and monic $g_1,h_1\in A'[x]$ with $f=g_1h_1$ in $A'[x]$ whose images in $(A'/IA')[x]$ are $\beta(G)$ and $\beta(H)$.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07M1, last sentence ('In this case the result follows from Lemma lemma-lift-factorization-monic'; Lemma Tag 0ALH)

proof.text: *Conclusion.* $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is the composite of $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A_1$ and $\operatorname{Spec}A_1\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ (functoriality of $\operatorname{Spec}$), both etale, hence etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (2). The map $A/I\to A'/IA'$ induced by $A\to A'$ is $\alpha=\beta\circ\alpha_1$ (both are induced by $A\to A_1\to A'$), an isomorphism. Let $v$ be the image of $u$ in $A'$, a unit, whose image in $A'/IA'$ is $\beta(\bar u)$. Put $g'=vg_1$ and $h'=v^{-1}h_1$. Then $g'h'=g_1h_1=f$ in $A'[x]$; modulo $IA'$, $g'\mapsto\beta(\bar u)\beta(G)=\beta(\bar g_1)=\beta(\alpha_1(\bar g))=\alpha(\bar g)$ and $h'\mapsto\beta(\bar u)^{-1}\beta(H)=\beta(\bar h_1)=\alpha(\bar h)$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Section 15.11 (section-lifting), remark before Lemma Tag 07LX ('given etale ring maps A → A' → A'' such that A/I ≅ A'/IA' and A'/IA' ≅ A''/IA'' the composition A → A'' is also etale and also satisfies A/I ≅ A''/IA''', used without mention); undoing the replacement of g-bar, h-bar by u-bar^{-1} g-bar, u-bar h-bar, implicit in Stacks' 'we may replace', is written out by the agent

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_lift_coprime_factorization {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (f : A[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (g₀ h₀ : (A ⧸ I)[X]) (hfactor : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = g₀ * h₀) (hleading : IsUnit g₀.leadingCoeff) (hcoprime : IsCoprime g₀ h₀) : ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (φ : A →+* A'), let J : Ideal A' := I.map φ let α : A ⧸ I →+* A' ⧸ J := Ideal.quotientMap J φ Ideal.le_comap_map AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ∧ Function.Bijective α ∧ ∃ g' h' : A'[X], f.map φ = g' * h' ∧ g'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = g₀.map α ∧ h'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = h₀.map α
